The '''Imperial remote post''' was a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] outpost established in the [[ruined Rakata machine chamber]] in [[the Tomb]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. [[Special Operations Group Two|Operations Group Two]] appropriated a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] structure and converted it to a military outpost, but when the [[Esh-kha]] overwhelmed the Imperials and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them, only a handful of Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were left to man the deserted outpost.
